Ellen —

Thanks for the heads-up. We can support both requests; a couple of details/constraints so you can plan:

• Delegated reviewer: we can create a scoped, auditor-only account (email-based) and add Michael Cho as the delegated reviewer. Please confirm the exact email address we should provision for him and whether he requires download rights.

• Evidence bundle (ZIP): we can produce a curated archive that includes the SOC 2 Type II report (redwood), an evidence index CSV, and the primary exhibits referenced by the auditor. We typically limit the zip to authorized artifacts (no operational logs unless explicitly requested) and stamp the bundle with a manifest.

• Portal link policy: the guest links we issue are timeboxed. Our standard one-time guest links expire after 48 hours; for auditors we can create a scoped one-time token that lasts up to 96 hours on request. We do not allow re-sharing of the primary guest link — delegated accounts are the proper route.

If you confirm Michael's email and that he needs download rights, I'll ask Marissa to create the scoped access and prepare the evidence-archive.zip. If procurement needs the archive delivered via SFTP or an approved file-transfer service (ShareFile/Box), let us know.

Best,
